column1: # Skill-name alias table for check-harness (spec D3). The single source of
# aliases: no other file in check-harness hard-codes these names.
# Columns are tab-separated. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
#   prefix             owner rename, applied to the part before the first ":"
#   rename             whole-key rename, applied after prefix; from and to are full keys
#   builtin            bare names shipped with Claude Code (no SKILL.md on disk); to = -
#   builtin-namespace  owners whose skills are all built-in; to = -
# This list is static and lags new Claude Code releases; an unlisted built-in
# shows as a ghost until a row is added here.
